dialogues.jp: 「しかし、ここはいつ見ても春満開だよな……」
dialogues.en:
"Honestly, no matter where I go, I see the full bloom of
spring..."
dialogues.text:
"Honestly, no matter where I go, I see the full bloom of
spring..."

dialogues.jp: どこまで行っても、桜、桜、桜である。
dialogues.en: Everywhere I went was a ton of sakura petals.
dialogues.text: Everywhere I went was a ton of sakura petals.

dialogues.jp:
ハトの群れに似て、追い散らしてやりたい欲求
に駆られるが、あいにくここの桜はキリがない。
dialogues.en:
Like a flock of pidgeons which you've just given a piece of
bread to; they chase you down no matter where you are.
dialogues.text:
Like a flock of pidgeons which you've just given a piece of
bread to; they chase you down no matter where you are.

dialogues.jp:
「キリがあったら、ポン刀振り回して、暴れ回っ
　てやるのに……」
dialogues.en:
"Brandishing his trusty sword, cutting and slicing, and
ready to run riot..."
dialogues.text:
"Brandishing his trusty sword, cutting and slicing, and
ready to run riot..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何を物騒な事を言ってるんですか」
dialogues.en: "What kind of dangerous things are you talking about now?"
dialogues.text: "What kind of dangerous things are you talking about now?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「振り回して、いい？」
dialogues.en: "May I swing my sword?"
dialogues.text: "May I swing my sword?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私に｛き／訊｝かないでくださいよ……」
dialogues.en: "You don't need my word to do so..."
dialogues.text: "You don't need my word to do so..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ことりは俺の女神なんで」
dialogues.en: "Well, you are my Goddess after all."
dialogues.text: "Well, you are my Goddess after all."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……おかしな冗談ですね」
dialogues.en: "...That was a weird joke."
dialogues.text: "...That was a weird joke."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ま、俺はおかしい奴なんで。それで、こんな
　所で何やってるの？」
dialogues.en: "Well, I'm a weird person. Anyway, what're you doing here?"
dialogues.text: "Well, I'm a weird person. Anyway, what're you doing here?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君こそ、どうしたんです？」
dialogues.en: "Well, what're you doing here?"
dialogues.text: "Well, what're you doing here?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「俺？　俺は、何となくぶらぶらと」
dialogues.en: "Me? I'm just more or less wandering around."
dialogues.text: "Me? I'm just more or less wandering around."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何となく？　散歩ですか？」
dialogues.en: "More or less? Taking a walk?"
dialogues.text: "More or less? Taking a walk?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「散歩というか、電波というか……誰かが、俺
　に命令するんだよな」
dialogues.en:
"Wal...king... I feel like someone is controlling me via
ultramagnetic waves...who is it?!"
dialogues.text:
"Wal...king... I feel like someone is controlling me via
ultramagnetic waves...who is it?!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「冗談だよ……で、ことりは？」
dialogues.en: I'm joking... what about you?"
dialogues.text: I'm joking... what about you?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「私は、公園の奥の、桜の大木に行こうと思う
　んです。歌を歌いに」
dialogues.en:
"I was thinking of going to the big sakura tree inside the
park. I feel like singing."
dialogues.text:
"I was thinking of going to the big sakura tree inside the
park. I feel like singing."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「歌、か。物陰から、こっそり聴かせてもらっ
　ていい？」
dialogues.en: "Singing huh? If I don't make any noise, can I listen?"
dialogues.text: "Singing huh? If I don't make any noise, can I listen?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ごめんなさい。ちょっと、人が居ると気が散
　るから……」
dialogues.en:
"I'm sorry. I'd rather not sing in front of others just
yet..."
dialogues.text:
"I'm sorry. I'd rather not sing in front of others just
yet..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そっか」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「歌い始めると、気にならないんですけどね。
　初めからは、ちょっと」
dialogues.en:
"When I'm in the middle of my song, I don't notice anything
around me. But when I'm trying to start..."
dialogues.text:
"When I'm in the middle of my song, I don't notice anything
around me. But when I'm trying to start..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「集中し始めると、他の事は気にならないん
　だ？」
dialogues.en:
"You're even more acutely aware of your surroundings than
usual?"
dialogues.text:
"You're even more acutely aware of your surroundings than
usual?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ええ、まあ、そうなんです」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, you could say that."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, you could say that."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、それじゃ、私はこれで。バイバイ」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I'd better go now. Bye bye!"
dialogues.text: "Ah, I'd better go now. Bye bye!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「んじゃ」
dialogues.en: "Later."
dialogues.text: "Later."

dialogues.jp: お互いに手を振ると、ことりは去っていった。
dialogues.en: We exchanged waves as Kotori left the area.
dialogues.text: We exchanged waves as Kotori left the area.

dialogues.jp: 「さて、と。ぶらぶらしますかね」
dialogues.en: "Oh well. Time for more aimless loitering."
dialogues.text: "Oh well. Time for more aimless loitering."

dialogues.jp:
何とはなしにむなしさを覚えつつ、公園を｛はいかい／徘徊｝
する俺だった。
dialogues.en: Like a lifeless, mindless zombie, I stumble around the park.
dialogues.text: Like a lifeless, mindless zombie, I stumble around the park.

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりの歌を聴きたかった◆
dialogues.en: ◆Listening to Kotori's song◆
dialogues.text: ◆Listening to Kotori's song◆

dialogues.jp: 何となくぶらついていると、ことりに出会った。
dialogues.en: While wandering around aimlessly, I ran into Kotori.
dialogues.text: While wandering around aimlessly, I ran into Kotori.

dialogues.jp:
ことりは例の桜の大木の所に、歌を歌いに来た
らしかったが、一緒して良いかを｛たず／訊｝ねると、断
られてしまった。
dialogues.en:
Kotori was heading to the big sakura tree to sing. My
request to join her was refused.
dialogues.text:
Kotori was heading to the big sakura tree to sing. My
request to join her was refused.

dialogues.jp: ちょっと寂しい……。
dialogues.en: Kinda lonely...
dialogues.text: Kinda lonely...
